description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management project. It generates a web page displaying free test cases (i.e., test cases not assigned to any test plan) for a specified test project. The script initializes the page environment, retrieves relevant test case data from the database via a test project manager class, formats data into a table with options for sorting and filtering, and renders the output using Smarty templates.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class likely used for rendering advanced sortable and filterable HTML tables in the web interface.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines the columns for the test cases table, conditional on whether importance management is enabled.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Collects and processes input parameters from GET, POST, or session to initialize the page context.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has the right to view test plan metrics for the project.
